pass_a_gloss: Concerning the parable of the farmers. Seeing the Son, the wise of the people not altogether unaware of their own superiority have-supposed him to-be heir; and they-dare also to-kill him in-order-that themselves lords of the vineyard they-may-become. Having-cast-out him they-killed; and immediately the of-the-vineyard Lord arrives having-risen from dead, and bad-ones badly the farmers destroys, but to other farmers the apostles hands-over the vineyard. Then he-answers from the prophecy that by those he-was-rejected, but with God is honored and head of corner; «Will-be-taken from you the kingdom of God and will-be-given to a nation doing its fruits.»
pass_b_english: On the parable of the farmers. The people’s wise ones, seeing the Son, take him for the heir and dare to kill him to own the vineyard. They cast him out and kill him; then the vineyard’s Lord arrives, [[raised from the dead >> Bible:Matthew 21:38-41]], destroys the bad farmers badly, and hands the vineyard to other farmers — the apostles. He answers from prophecy that he was rejected by them yet is precious with God and [[head of the corner >> Bible:Psalm 118:22]]; [[the kingdom of God will be taken from you and given to a nation producing its fruits >> Bible:Matthew 21:43]].
